verdict.rationale: Codex documents several one-command install paths: the in-agent `/plugins` browser, which installs from a configured marketplace and tells you to start a new session before using bundled skills; `codex plugin marketplace add`; and `$skill-installer <name>` for curated skills. A hands-on probe confirmed that a real one-liner (`npx -y skills add openai/plugins --skill plugin-creator -a codex`) installs the skill into `.agents/skills`, which Codex scans automatically.
